name: Glitch
author: Ambrotype
description: A task for breaking photos on purpose: pixel sorting, RGB split, channel drift, a broken video signal, datamosh and JPEG blocks, VHS, ripples, streaks and tiles, and print looks (Game Boy dither, newsprint, ring and line screens, rainbow stripes), with the Effects panel open to tune them (each kept to the highlights, the shadows or a colour if you like, and pushed to 200 %). A task plugin: a tab with its own layout and buttons, and no code.

task.label: Glitch
task.hint: Broken on purpose: pixel sorting, datamosh, VHS, dither, ring screens

layout.name: Glitch
layout.description: The Glitch task's tools on the left, the Effects panel open on the right to tune them.
